(1) These Rules may be called the Boiler Operation (Amendment) Rules, 2021. (2) They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 2. In the Boiler Operation Rules, 2021 , in rule 30, in clause (b), the following Note shall be inserted, namely:- "Note : Any integration or combination with the above-mentioned branches of Engineering, for example, Electrical and Electronics, Electrical and Instrumentation, etc. shall also be allowed.". [F. No. P-30012/2/2020-Boilers] SUMIT A DA WRA, Addl. Secy. Note : The principal rules were published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- section ( i) vide notification number G.S.R. 11 S(E), dated the 16th February, 2021 .
